top_signals.title: Macao casinos hit by slump as China crackdown rattles market
top_signals.summary: The slump ends 16 straight months of growth and comes as Beijing steps up efforts to stem capital outflow.

top_signals.title: Fujifilm Shares Tumble by a Record After Earnings Disappoint
top_signals.summary: Fujifilm Holdings Corp. shares tumbled by the most on record in Tokyo trading after the medical equipment maker reported first-quarter results that fell short of expectations.

top_signals.title: Most U.K. teens to opt out of planned social media curfew, poll finds
top_signals.summary: Most teenagers would opt out of a U.K. government plan to impose social media curfews between midnight and 6 a.m. on older teenagers, according to a poll.
